uiActions.name: list_documents
uiActions.description: List documents, optionally only those in one folder.

uiActions.name: read_document
uiActions.description: Read a document's content, optionally at an earlier revision.

uiActions.name: create_document
uiActions.description: Create a Markdown or HTML document.

uiActions.name: update_document
uiActions.description: Change a document's content, title or folder. expected_revision must be the revision you read; a newer revision is a conflict to resolve by re-reading.

uiActions.name: restore_version
uiActions.description: Restore an earlier revision's content as the newest revision. Title and folder are not restored, so a rename or move revision restores nothing visible.

uiActions.name: delete_document
uiActions.description: Delete a document and its history.
uiActions.approvalReason: Deleting a document also deletes its history and cannot be undone.

uiActions.name: import_documents
uiActions.description: Ask the owner to choose Markdown, HTML or text files to import as new documents. Waits up to 20 seconds for the owner's choice in their prompt, then returns the new documents and any file that could not be imported. While the owner has not chosen it returns {pending: true, importId}: call again with that importId to keep waiting (the request stays open for ten minutes).

files.description: Files already read as UTF-8 text (the window passes the files its person chose); the owner is not asked.

uiActions.name: export_document
uiActions.description: Offer the owner a copy of a document to save on their computer. Returns the offered file name; the owner saves it from their prompt.

uiActions.name: snapshot_documents
uiActions.description: Keep a consistent copy of every document and its history, taken by Chariox outside the App's data. Chariox keeps the newest two.

uiActions.name: save_draft
uiActions.description: Keep the unsaved edit that one editor (a window) has of an open document, started from base_revision, so a replaced window finds it again. Replaces that editor's earlier draft of that document, and only that one; saving the document is update_document.

uiActions.name: claim_draft
uiActions.description: The unsaved edit a window starts with: its own editor's latest draft, otherwise a copy of the most recently kept draft of another editor, written under this editor's name; the other editor's draft stays. Null when there is none. A draft of a deleted document is not offered. A draft is removed only by its editor (discard_draft) or once it is a day old.

uiActions.name: discard_draft
uiActions.description: Drop one editor's unsaved edit of the document id once it is saved or given up; other editors' drafts and other documents' drafts stay.
